retired_decisions.reason: MIDI can carry symbolic observations and realizations but not live source-time transport semantics.
Layered mashups require independent persistent source transports.
Signal qualification and human musical acceptance are separate authorities.
It may remain a mechanism, but proof-carrying musical law owns admissibility.
Musical recurrence and correspondence require multidimensional evidence.
Selected material and obligations must execute or refuse explicitly.
Temporary overlays and self-modifying workflows are not product history.
Release experiments must enter one Floor/review/publication lineage.

theses.open_condition: Whole-organism passage remains false until all required Buffalo organs circulate on one specimen.
theses.statement: EarCrate is one provenance-preserving musical organism: evidence becomes observations, accepted musical understanding, lawful choices, several executable bodies, performance, review, selective recomputation, and changed future behavior.
Authoritative score, community-symbolic witness, blind PCM inference, convergence, performance, human review, and campaign evidence retain separate ancestry.
The cephalopod reader produces waveform-grounded observations and candidates; it does not silently become composition or publication authority.
A crate describes available material; a mashup requires persistent independent source transports, playheads, cues, loops, jumps, fades, cuts, and mixer state.
Two turntables remain the control metaphor, but the renderer must support N channels for beds, fills, one-shots, textures, and transitions.
A sample is fungible only for a declared musical slot under role, time, transform, identity, future-obligation, and rights constraints.

Commodity MIR, ML, DSP, rights, transport, and review providers may emit observations, candidates, measurements, refusals, derived artifacts, or unapplied patches; they may not write canonical musical state.
A successful reader, score parser, rack, renderer, or deck demo may pass its organ gate without implying whole-Buffalo passage.
Loudness, peak, silence, recurrence, seam, and reproducibility checks can qualify a candidate for listening but cannot approve the music.

theses.open_condition: No committed specimen yet proves campaign evidence changing a later musical decision.
theses.statement: Review is not complete learning until a correction creates a child revision, invalidates only dependents, and changes a later ranking, policy, or choice.
Source bytes, decoded PCM, models, programs, decisions, events, stems, masters, and revisions are content-addressed and must execute or refuse explicitly.

The repository stores identities, manifests, schemas, annotations, policies, builders, and receipts; copyrighted recordings, scores, and private-library media stay external unless explicitly permitted.

Deck playback, separation, beat tracking, embeddings, transcription, stretching, and catalogs are replaceable organs; EarCrate owns custody, adjudication, obligations, performance score, and causal review.
A selected layer, event, source, or obligation may not disappear behind a rescue, degraded, floor-safe, or silent fallback path.
The end-state must hear, understand, choose lawfully, compose, realize through several media, perform, accept correction, and behave differently afterward.
